description: Land Acquisition - Compensations for the acquisitions of Lands in Balakaduwawatta & etc., Akurana D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired, their boundaries, and compensation matters. The content focuses solely on land and property-related administrative procedures without any government personnel changes, structural modifications, or other specialized categories.
